panels.description: Streets are Overture Maps segments, read straight from its GeoParquet on S3 and cut into 50 m pieces in DuckDB. Each piece takes the travel time of the R5 cell under its midpoint. The dots are services from Overture's base theme (OpenStreetMap): Salud, Educación, Parques and Centros comerciales, each shown at the minute R5 first reaches its footprint. Click to move the origin; press play to watch the city light up minute by minute.

targets.rawSql:
-- Waits on $calles, which materialises Overture's streets once per dashboard load.
SELECT c.minutos, s.class,
       (($fecha || ' 07:00:00')::TIMESTAMP + INTERVAL (c.minutos) MINUTE) AS time,
       ST_AsHEXWKB(s.g) AS geom
FROM "calles_ov_${ov_release:raw}" s
JOIN (SELECT minutos, ST_GeomFromHEXWKB(geom) AS cg FROM read_json_auto('http://iso-cuenca:8099/cells.json?' || 'lat=' || $lat || '&lon=' || $lng || '&date=' || $fecha ||
         '&calle=' || $calle || '&transit=${publico:csv}' ||
         '&walk=' || $apie || '&rides=' || $trasbordos || '&max=' || $cutoff)) c
  ON ST_Within(ST_LineInterpolatePoint(s.g, 0.5), c.cg)
SELECT try_cast($lat AS DOUBLE) AS latitude, try_cast($lng AS DOUBLE) AS longitude

-- Waits on $servicios, which materialises Overture's services once per dashboard load.
WITH alcance AS (
  SELECT s.id, s.categoria, s.nombre, s.latitude, s.longitude, min(c.minutos) AS minutos
  FROM "servicios_ov_${ov_release:raw}" s
  JOIN (SELECT minutos, ST_GeomFromHEXWKB(geom) AS cg FROM read_json_auto('http://iso-cuenca:8099/cells.json?' || 'lat=' || $lat || '&lon=' || $lng || '&date=' || $fecha ||
         '&calle=' || $calle || '&transit=${publico:csv}' ||
         '&walk=' || $apie || '&rides=' || $trasbordos || '&max=' || $cutoff)) c
    ON ST_Intersects(s.g, c.cg)
  GROUP BY ALL
)
SELECT categoria, nombre, minutos, latitude, longitude,
       (($fecha || ' 07:00:00')::TIMESTAMP + INTERVAL (minutos) MINUTE) AS time
FROM alcance

panels.title: Every street reachable from the white dot, coloured by the minute R5 reaches it

panels.description: How many of each kind of service R5 reaches from the white dot by the end of the map's time window — drag the brush or pause the animation and this follows. Never past the cutoff. The Map categories filter does not apply here.

targets.rawSql:
-- Waits on $servicios. Counts what is reached by the end of the map's time window ($t_fin).
WITH alcance AS (
  SELECT s.id, s.categoria, s.nombre, s.latitude, s.longitude, min(c.minutos) AS minutos
  FROM "servicios_ov_${ov_release:raw}" s
  JOIN (SELECT minutos, ST_GeomFromHEXWKB(geom) AS cg FROM read_json_auto('http://iso-cuenca:8099/cells.json?' || 'lat=' || $lat || '&lon=' || $lng || '&date=' || $fecha ||
         '&calle=' || $calle || '&transit=${publico:csv}' ||
         '&walk=' || $apie || '&rides=' || $trasbordos || '&max=' || $cutoff)) c
    ON ST_Intersects(s.g, c.cg)
  GROUP BY ALL
)
SELECT
       count(DISTINCT id) FILTER (WHERE categoria = 'Salud') AS "Salud",
       count(DISTINCT id) FILTER (WHERE categoria = 'Educación') AS "Educación",
       count(DISTINCT id) FILTER (WHERE categoria = 'Parques') AS "Parques",
       count(DISTINCT id) FILTER (WHERE categoria = 'Centros comerciales') AS "Centros comerciales"
FROM alcance WHERE minutos <= greatest(0, least(coalesce(date_diff('minute', ($fecha || ' 07:00:00')::TIMESTAMP,
    try_cast(try_cast($t_fin AS TIMESTAMPTZ) AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' AS TIMESTAMP)), try_cast($cutoff AS INTEGER)),
  try_cast($cutoff AS INTEGER)))

panels.description: Travel time to the closest service of each kind among those reached by the end of the map's time window. A dash means none is reached yet.

targets.rawSql:
-- Waits on $servicios. Nearest of each kind reached by the end of the map's time window ($t_fin).
WITH alcance AS (
  SELECT s.id, s.categoria, s.nombre, s.latitude, s.longitude, min(c.minutos) AS minutos

         '&calle=' || $calle || '&transit=${publico:csv}' ||
         '&walk=' || $apie || '&rides=' || $trasbordos || '&max=' || $cutoff)) c
    ON ST_Intersects(s.g, c.cg)
  GROUP BY ALL
)
SELECT
       min(minutos) FILTER (WHERE categoria = 'Salud') AS "Salud",
       min(minutos) FILTER (WHERE categoria = 'Educación') AS "Educación",
       min(minutos) FILTER (WHERE categoria = 'Parques') AS "Parques",
       min(minutos) FILTER (WHERE categoria = 'Centros comerciales') AS "Centros comerciales"
FROM alcance WHERE minutos <= greatest(0, least(coalesce(date_diff('minute', ($fecha || ' 07:00:00')::TIMESTAMP,
    try_cast(try_cast($t_fin AS TIMESTAMPTZ) AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' AS TIMESTAMP)), try_cast($cutoff AS INTEGER)),

panels.title: Minutes to the nearest

panels.description: Cumulative count of each kind of service reached by every minute of the journey, up to the end of the map's time window.

targets.rawSql:
-- Waits on $servicios. Services reached by each minute, up to the end of the map's time window ($t_fin).
WITH alcance AS (
  SELECT s.id, s.categoria, s.nombre, s.latitude, s.longitude, min(c.minutos) AS minutos
  FROM "servicios_ov_${ov_release:raw}" s
  JOIN (SELECT minutos, ST_GeomFromHEXWKB(geom) AS cg FROM read_json_auto('http://iso-cuenca:8099/cells.json?' || 'lat=' || $lat || '&lon=' || $lng || '&date=' || $fecha ||
         '&calle=' || $calle || '&transit=${publico:csv}' ||
         '&walk=' || $apie || '&rides=' || $trasbordos || '&max=' || $cutoff)) c
    ON ST_Intersects(s.g, c.cg)
  GROUP BY ALL
),
m AS (SELECT range AS minuto FROM range(0, (greatest(0, least(coalesce(date_diff('minute', ($fecha || ' 07:00:00')::TIMESTAMP,
    try_cast(try_cast($t_fin AS TIMESTAMPTZ) AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' AS TIMESTAMP)), try_cast($cutoff AS INTEGER)),
  try_cast($cutoff AS INTEGER))))::BIGINT + 1))
SELECT m.minuto AS "Minutes",
       count(DISTINCT a.id) FILTER (WHERE a.categoria = 'Salud' AND a.minutos <= m.minuto) AS "Salud",
       count(DISTINCT a.id) FILTER (WHERE a.categoria = 'Educación' AND a.minutos <= m.minuto) AS "Educación",
       count(DISTINCT a.id) FILTER (WHERE a.categoria = 'Parques' AND a.minutos <= m.minuto) AS "Parques",
       count(DISTINCT a.id) FILTER (WHERE a.categoria = 'Centros comerciales' AND a.minutos <= m.minuto) AS "Centros comerciales"
FROM m LEFT JOIN alcance a ON true
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Services reached, minute by minute

panels.description: Every service reached by the end of the map's time window, nearest first. Names come from OpenStreetMap through Overture; an unnamed one shows its category.

targets.rawSql:
-- Waits on $servicios. Every service reached by the end of the map's time window ($t_fin), nearest first.
WITH alcance AS (
  SELECT s.id, s.categoria, s.nombre, s.latitude, s.longitude, min(c.minutos) AS minutos
  FROM "servicios_ov_${ov_release:raw}" s
  JOIN (SELECT minutos, ST_GeomFromHEXWKB(geom) AS cg FROM read_json_auto('http://iso-cuenca:8099/cells.json?' || 'lat=' || $lat || '&lon=' || $lng || '&date=' || $fecha ||
         '&calle=' || $calle || '&transit=${publico:csv}' ||
         '&walk=' || $apie || '&rides=' || $trasbordos || '&max=' || $cutoff)) c
    ON ST_Intersects(s.g, c.cg)
  GROUP BY ALL
)
SELECT nombre AS "Name", categoria AS "Category", minutos AS "Minutes"
FROM alcance WHERE minutos <= greatest(0, least(coalesce(date_diff('minute', ($fecha || ' 07:00:00')::TIMESTAMP,
    try_cast(try_cast($t_fin AS TIMESTAMPTZ) AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' AS TIMESTAMP)), try_cast($cutoff AS INTEGER)),
  try_cast($cutoff AS INTEGER)))
ORDER BY minutos, categoria, nombre

list.name: categoria

list.definition:
-- One read of Overture's STAC index per load: every file this dashboard needs, as
-- 'building=<url>;land_use=<url>,<url>,...;segment=<url>'. calles and servicios pick theirs out of it.
-- The collection name is read off the asset path, not off the index's own `collection`
-- column: Overture rewrote collections.parquet on 2026-09-22 and that column is now null
-- in every row.
SELECT string_agg(collection || '=' || hrefs, ';' ORDER BY collection) FROM (
  SELECT collection, string_agg(href, ',' ORDER BY href) AS hrefs
  FROM (
    SELECT regexp_extract(assets.aws.alternate.s3.href, 'type=([^/]*)/', 1) AS collection,
           replace(assets.aws.alternate.s3.href, 's3://overturemaps-us-west-2/',
                   'https://overturemaps-us-west-2.s3.us-west-2.amazonaws.com/') AS href
    FROM 'https://stac.overturemaps.org/${ov_release}/collections.parquet'
    WHERE bbox.xmin <= -78.87 AND bbox.xmax >= -79.11 AND bbox.ymin <= -2.76 AND bbox.ymax >= -3.02)
  WHERE collection IN ('segment', 'land_use', 'building')
  GROUP BY collection)

list.definition:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "calles_ov_${ov_release}" AS
WITH s AS (
  SELECT id, class, geometry AS g,
         greatest(1, ceil(ST_Length(geometry) * 111320 / 50))::INT AS n
  FROM read_parquet(regexp_extract('${ov_files}', 'segment=([^;]*)', 1))
  WHERE subtype = 'road' AND bbox.xmin <= -78.87 AND bbox.xmax >= -79.11 AND bbox.ymin <= -2.76 AND bbox.ymax >= -3.02
)
SELECT id, class, ST_LineSubstring(g, i / n, (i + 1) / n) AS g FROM s, range(n) r(i)

list.definition:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "servicios_ov_${ov_release}" AS
WITH lu AS (
  SELECT id, subtype, class, names.primary AS nombre, ST_GeomFromText(ST_AsText(geometry)) AS g
  FROM read_parquet(string_split(regexp_extract('${ov_files}', 'land_use=([^;]*)', 1), ','))
  WHERE bbox.xmin <= -78.87 AND bbox.xmax >= -79.11 AND bbox.ymin <= -2.76 AND bbox.ymax >= -3.02 AND class IN ('hospital', 'school', 'college', 'park', 'retail', 'commercial')
),
bu AS (
  SELECT id, names.primary AS nombre, ST_GeomFromText(ST_AsText(geometry)) AS g
  FROM read_parquet(regexp_extract('${ov_files}', 'building=([^;]*)', 1))
  WHERE bbox.xmin <= -78.87 AND bbox.xmax >= -79.11 AND bbox.ymin <= -2.76 AND bbox.ymax >= -3.02 AND regexp_matches(lower(names.primary), 'mall|shopping|centro comercial|plaza de las am[eé]ricas|mill?enn?ium plaza|racar plaza')
),
s AS (
  SELECT id, 'Salud' AS categoria, nombre, g FROM lu WHERE class = 'hospital'
  UNION ALL SELECT id, 'Educación', nombre, g FROM lu WHERE class IN ('school', 'college')
  UNION ALL SELECT id, 'Parques', nombre, g FROM lu WHERE class = 'park' AND (nombre IS NOT NULL OR ST_Area_Spheroid(g) >= 1000)
  UNION ALL SELECT id, 'Centros comerciales', nombre, g FROM lu
    WHERE class IN ('retail', 'commercial') AND regexp_matches(lower(nombre), 'mall|shopping|centro comercial|plaza de las am[eé]ricas|mill?enn?ium plaza|racar plaza') AND ST_Area_Spheroid(g) >= 50
  UNION ALL SELECT b.id, 'Centros comerciales', b.nombre, b.g FROM bu b
    WHERE ST_Area_Spheroid(b.g) >= 50
      AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM lu WHERE lu.class IN ('retail', 'commercial') AND ST_Intersects(lu.g, b.g))
)
SELECT id, categoria, coalesce(nombre, categoria) AS nombre, g,
       ST_Y(ST_PointOnSurface(g)) AS latitude, ST_X(ST_PointOnSurface(g)) AS longitude
FROM s
